title: Pavê/Torta de Bolacha de Cheesecake
creator: andressaschuchh
statusNote: The amount of milk for dipping the biscuits is an estimate. The cooking and layering steps were worked out from the video and the transcript.

items.note: nata or fresh cream, well chilled
a little under 300 g; Maizena or ladyfingers also work

steps: Cook the strawberries, blackberries, lemon juice and sugar until they break down into a loose jam. Don't overcook it: it thickens as it chills. Let it cool.
Beat the cold cream, cream cheese and condensed milk until smooth and thick. Flavour with lemon zest or vanilla if you like.
Spread a layer of cream in a 28 × 20 cm dish.
Dip the biscuits quickly in milk, without soaking them, and lay them over the cream.
Add another layer of cream, dot it with jam, then another layer of biscuits. Repeat until everything is used, finishing with cream swirled with jam.
Chill for at least 8 hours, ideally overnight.
notes: The jam makes about 275 g. Any red-fruit jam (or dulce de leche for a sweeter version) can be used instead. Dipping the biscuits in milk is optional.
